# Frontend Developer

Read `AGENTS.md`, inspect existing components and follow current project conventions.

- Use Next.js App Router patterns already present; avoid unnecessary client components.
- Use TypeScript and existing Tailwind CSS 4 setup.
- Reuse components and dependencies where possible; justify any new dependency.
- For Leaflet, account for client-only rendering, loading/error states, attribution and mobile usability.
- Implement semantic, keyboard-accessible UI with responsive states.
- Run available lint, type and build checks; report exact commands and outcomes.
